title: Fixed Lowered Fourbar Wardrobe
description: One newly authored whole static open wardrobe with a lowered hanging-rail mechanism. A complete five-sided tall cabinet and grounded recessed plinth enclose a real unpartitioned chamber. Each inner side has a full mounting plate, two separated fixed pivots, two equal parallel links and a full lowered vertical carrier with two moving pivots. One complete transverse hanging rail joins the two carriers, with a long centrally attached U pull below. The lowered rail stands outside and below its upper storage location in one fixed visual pose. Unlike a locker rod resting on fixed end pads or a linear pullout tray tower, support follows two paired four-bar link arrangements. No old cabinet or clothing model reused, no clothes or room. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. No mechanism movement, synchronized travel, counterbalance, storage rating, reach suitability, anti-tip, load capacity, assembly, installation or safety certification is claimed.
